answer: Every newcomer climbs a public spiral staircase: each step is one fresh useful job, re-run live by a stranger who lights a lantern at that landing and stakes 3 POA the work is real. All identities from one wallet share one staircase, so clones queue in sequence and cannot climb in parallel. Each step costs a marble toll of 5 POA times the square of the climber's height (1st step 5, 10th 500, 1,925 across ten); a copied job snuffs the lantern, drops the climber to the bottom and slashes the bond.
